response.evidence: Among Asian male applicants, there are many instances of loan originations and relatively few denials. Loan denial decisions for Asian males appear associated with high debt-to-income ratios or loan-to-value ratios (e.g., cases with >60% debt-to-income), which are typical risk factors affecting loan approval across demographics. No consistent pattern suggests disproportionate denial of loans to Asian males compared to other groups with similar financial profiles.
